General-content county map showing rural buildings and landholders' names; the urban insets show real-property lots, building coverage, and some occupants' names. Hand col. to emphasize municipal boundaries and territories. Originally printed on 6 sheets (later conjoined). LC sheets imperfect: Brittle, shellacked, cracked, torn at edges, some sheets water-stained. Includes local business directories, population statistical tables, and strait-line distance table.
